parties: Vishal Mehta (acquirer); Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited
headline: Vishal Mehta files substantial acquisition disclosure for Odigma Consultancy Solutions
sum: Vishal Mehta has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a substantial share acquisition in Odigma Consultancy Solutions Limited. The filing marks formal notice to the stock exchange of a triggering acquisition event.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are mandatory within 2 IIM (working days) of crossing 5% threshold; this filing confirms the 5% creep or formal open offer trigger has been breached, requiring full PA/OFS mechanics review under current SEBI M&A rules.
detail: Vishal Mehta has submitted to NSE a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation mandates disclosure when an acquirer crosses 5% of paid-up capital or voting rights, or makes any further acquisition thereafter. The disclosure is a prerequisite trigger for either a mandatory open offer (if 25% threshold is crossed) or continued 2% creep disclosures. The filing was made on the NSE corporate portal, confirming the transaction is in public domain.
